text: A hunter finds a device communicating through an unexpected interface and needs the adapter name, MAC address, assigned IP addresses, DNS servers, and connected network information. Which Advanced Hunting table provides that configuration context?

A hunter wants authentication evidence that can include on-premises Active Directory activity captured by Defender for Identity as well as authentication activity from Microsoft online services. Which table should be queried?

A phishing hunt starts from a suspicious email. The analyst needs to identify the URLs contained in the message and determine whether recipients later clicked those links through Safe Links. Which TWO Advanced Hunting tables directly provide those two views?

A campaign uses the same malicious attachment name across many messages. The hunter wants attachment filenames, file types, and available file hashes from Defender for Office 365 telemetry. Which table is designed for this data?

A junior analyst understands the hunting goal but is not yet comfortable writing Kusto Query Language from scratch. Which Advanced Hunting mode is intended to let the analyst build the hunt by selecting filters and conditions instead?
A threat hunter has a useful Advanced Hunting query that every analyst in the same tenant should be able to find and run from the portal. Where should the query be saved?

Several hunts repeat the same normalization and enrichment logic with different input values. The team wants that query logic to be reusable with parameters instead of copying it into every hunt. Which Advanced Hunting feature best fits?

An Advanced Hunting query returns a Timestamp column. Without adding charting code, which visualization does the results experience automatically render to help the hunter spot bursts and unusual trends over time?

choices.text: A process tree for every row

text: A hunter needs to keep the existing columns in a result set and add a new calculated field named AccountKey built from other columns. Which KQL operator is designed for that task?

A query returns thousands of authentication events, but the hunter only wants the unique combinations of AccountUpn and DeviceName that appear in the results. Which KQL operator is the most direct choice?

A hunter groups events by source IP and wants an efficient estimate of how many different user accounts each IP attempted to authenticate as. Which KQL aggregation function best matches that requirement?

While reviewing a hunting graph, an analyst selects a suspicious device and wants to reveal the next set of assets related to that node so the investigation can move outward from the initial result. Which graph action supports this?

An identity hunter wants to determine which paths a compromised account could use through role assignments and group memberships to reach a critical Azure resource. Which capability is best suited to this relationship-heavy question?

A team begins a proactive investigation with a written hypothesis and wants to record whether the hypothesis is validated, keep investigation notes, and track analytic rules or incidents created from the findings. Which Sentinel construct is designed for that workflow?

During a Sentinel hunt, an analyst bookmarks a suspicious event and later determines that the evidence is severe enough to require formal investigation by the incident-response queue. What should the analyst do with that bookmarked finding?

choices.text: Escalate the bookmark to an incident
Convert it to a data connector
Move it to a custom log table
Turn it into an ingestion transformation

text: A hunter needs to investigate long-retained Sentinel data and run a complex query that joins several tables before persisting useful results for further analysis. Which TWO characteristics make a Data lake KQL job appropriate?

choices.text: It can query historical data retained for up to 12 years
It supports complex KQL such as joins and unions across tables
It is optimized for hydrating results from one source table
It queries the analytics tier without data lake onboarding
It uses the restricted operator set associated with search jobs

text: A SOC wants a background aggregation every 20 minutes over high-volume Basic-tier firewall data, and the workspace is not onboarded to the Sentinel data lake. Which feature is the better fit?

A threat-hunting notebook needs reusable security-focused Python capabilities for querying data, enrichment, anomaly detection, and visualization. Which package is specifically designed for this use in Microsoft Sentinel notebooks?
